verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes a public pricing page in its docs that explains billing factors such as search context size, Pro Search and Agent API tool usage. Self-serve API credits drive automatic tier upgrades, and onboarding is a get-a-key-in-minutes flow, so no sales contact is implied. The community also refers to visible public pricing. However, the excerpts never show actual per-request, per-token or per-credit rates, so the 'clear' part is only inferred. missing for 10: concrete published per-request/per-token/per-credit price figures in evidence, explicit no-sales self-serve billing statement, independent confirmation of pricing clarity
